title: PaperOrchestra: Turn Research Notes Into a Paper Draft

facts.method: Pinned official repository README and research paper.
facts.limits: Model provider credentials may cost money; generated claims, citations and figures must be checked by the author. Not an officially supported Google product.

scenes.say: Turn messy research notes into a paper draft. Meet Paper Orchestra, a multi agent research writing framework.
scenes.heading: NOTES INTO A PAPER

scenes.say: Give it your ideas, experimental logs, and a LaTeX template.
scenes.heading: START WITH YOUR RESEARCH

scenes.say: Specialist agents build an outline, search related literature, draft sections, and refine the manuscript.
scenes.heading: A TEAM OF AGENTS

scenes.say: An optional plotting agent can generate figures. The output is a LaTeX manuscript, ready for you to review.
scenes.heading: PLOTS MEET PAPER

scenes.say: You still need to check every claim, citation, and chart. You need model access and API keys, which can cost money.
scenes.heading: CHECK THE WORK

scenes.say: Want the repo? Comment PAPER and follow Hypeless for more tools, minus the hype.
scenes.heading: YOUR CALL

viewer.problem: Turning ideas and experimental results into a paper draft takes time
viewer.job: Understand what the research-writing agents do and where human verification is necessary

idea: Turn research materials into a LaTeX paper draft using coordinated specialist agents.

claims.text: A multi-agent framework turns research ideas and experimental logs into LaTeX manuscripts.
Agents handle outlining, literature review, writing, refinement and optional figure generation.
Model providers require credentials and generated output should be checked.
